verdict.rationale: Khoj documents official self-host installation via Docker or Pip and references a standard docker-compose.yml, so the Docker Compose path is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows Kubernetes/Helm, VPS-specific or Raspberry Pi guides. One community report of a failed docker build (a pyside6 dependency error) lowers confidence in how well the Docker path is maintained. Missing for 10: Kubernetes/Helm deployment guide, dedicated VPS guide, Raspberry Pi/ARM guide, evidence that each guide is maintained.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, official deployment paths cover my target — Docker Compose, Kubernetes/Helm, a small VPS, or a Raspberry Pi — each with its own maintained guide

citations.quote: You can install the Khoj server using either Docker or Pip
If you're using Docker, online search should work out of the box with searxng using our standard docker-compose.yml.
You can self-host on consumer hardware for privacy
